title: Colony

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Colony Woodstock hosts special events throughout the year. From unforgettable weddings to milestone anniversaries and birthdays, to corporate outings and on-premise shoots for film, TV and photography. The moment you step inside our historic venue, you’ll instantly feel the welcoming vibe and spirit of a true Catskills artists’ haven. Although our building is nearly a century old, our amenities include modern state-of-the-art sound and lighting
